title: 第534章 想第一个死我成全你第533章 禁制消失踏入神殿
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
第534章想第一个死？我成全你！
“怎么回事？宝物呢？”
“就一尊破石像？”
金乌太子环顾四周，眼中满是失望与愤怒。
其余的天骄，也都是一脸的错愕。他们想过无数种可能，唯独没想到这神殿之内，竟然是这般景象。
但他们毕竟都是心智过人之辈，很快便将目光，重新聚焦到了那尊唯一的，不同寻常的雕像之上。
宝物，一定和这尊雕像有关！
楚风带着诸葛玥和月婵仙子，最后进入这片空间。
他第一眼，便看到了那尊散发着无尽蛮荒气息的雕像，以及雕像下，那个小小的身影。
“这是什么地方？”
楚风眉头紧锁，在心中问道。
下一刻，他识海中的葬天棺，猛地一震。
一道充满了震惊与不敢置信的意念，从夫子李耳的残魂中传来。
“这……这股气息……难道是……荒天帝？！”
夫子的声音，第一次出现了如此剧烈的波动，甚至带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖。
“什么？荒天帝？”
“那个以一己之力，平定太古黑暗动乱的禁忌存在？”
“不可能！他不是早就在那场席卷诸天的大战中，彻底陨落了吗？”
雷主、妖姬、九幽、无法和尚，这些曾经在各自时代叱咤风云的禁忌存在，在听到“荒天帝”这三个字的瞬间，全都炸了锅。
“荒天帝是谁？很有名吗？比那个黄金古族的先祖如何？”

楚风有些好奇地问道。
“何止有名！”夫子的声音，变得前所未有的凝重，“小子，你可知，在太古时代，帝境，亦有强弱之分。”
“寻常大帝，如那黄金古族的先祖，乃是凭借血脉之力，按部就班，证道成帝。而荒天帝，却是于微末中崛起，一路逆天而行，战出来的无上战帝！”
“他的战力，早已超越了帝境的范畴，被誉为最接近‘仙’的存在。若非太古仙路断绝，他或许早已飞升成仙。论战力，那黄金古族的先祖，给他提鞋都不配！”
“只可惜，太古末年，那场席卷诸天万界的大战爆发，连大帝都如草芥般陨落。那一战后，荒天帝也彻底消失了，所有人都以为他已经陨落……”
夫子说到这里，顿了顿，语气复杂地看着雕像下的阿蛮。
“如今看来，传言未必是真。小子，你身边这个叫阿蛮的小丫头，来头怕是比天还大！她，极有可能，就是荒天帝的血脉后裔！”
楚风的心，猛地一跳。
荒天帝的后裔？
怪不得……怪不得她能无视禁制，怪不得神庭要费尽心机地寻找她。
这哪里是什么钥匙，这分明就是一位小祖宗！
楚风再看向阿蛮的眼神，不由得柔和了几分。
而就在这时，那尊万丈高的荒天帝雕像，忽然发出了“咔嚓”一声轻响。
只见雕像那模糊不清的眉心处，裂开了一道缝隙。
紧接着，一团拳头大小，散发着七彩光芒的光团，从那缝隙之中缓缓地飘了出来。
那光团之中，仿佛蕴含着一个初生的宇宙，无数古老而玄奥的符文在其中生灭流转，一股比雕像本身还要纯粹、还要古老的蛮荒气息，瞬间席卷了整个空间！
传承！
真正的传承，出现了！
“轰！”
几乎是在光团出现的瞬间，在场所有天骄的呼吸，都变得粗重起来，眼中迸发出前所未有的贪婪与狂热。

他们能清晰地感觉到，那光团之中，蕴含着何等恐怖的力量！
只要得到它，别说万界天骄榜第一，就算是未来证道成帝，也并非不可能！
第534章想第一个死？我成全你！
“是我的！”
content_en:
Chapter 534 Want to be the first to die? I'll make it happen for you!
"What's going on? Where's the treasure?"
"Just a broken stone statue?"
Prince Jinwu looked around, his eyes full of disappointment and anger.
The rest of the geniuses also looked astonished. They thought about countless possibilities, but they never expected that there would be such a scene inside the temple.
But after all, they were all people with extraordinary minds, and they quickly refocused their attention on the unique and unusual statue.
The treasure must be related to this statue!
Chu Feng took Zhuge Yue and Fairy Yuechan and finally entered this space.
At his first glance, he saw the statue exuding an endless barbaric atmosphere, and the small figure under the statue.
"What is this place?"
Chu Feng frowned and asked in his heart.
The next moment, he saw the burial coffin in the sea and shook violently.
A thought full of shock and disbelief came from the remnant soul of Master Li Er.
"This...this aura...could it be...Emperor Huangtian?!"
For the first time, the master's voice fluctuated so violently, and even contained an imperceptible tremor.
"What? Emperor Huangtian?"
"The taboo existence that single-handedly quelled the ancient dark turmoil?"
"Impossible! Didn't he completely fall in that war that swept across the world?"
Thunder Lord, Enchantress, Jiuyou, and the Unable Monk, these taboo beings who were once all-powerful in their respective eras, all exploded the moment they heard the words "Desolate Heaven Emperor".
"Who is Huangtian Emperor? Is he very famous? How does he compare to the ancestor of the Golden Ancient Clan?"
Chu Feng asked curiously.
"More than just being famous!" Master's voice became more solemn than ever before, "Boy, do you know that in the ancient times, there were strong and weak people in the imperial realm."
"Ordinary great emperors, such as the ancestors of the Golden Ancient Clan, rely on the power of their bloodline to step by step and prove themselves to be emperors. However, Emperor Huangtian rose from the bottom of the world, went against the will of heaven, and became the supreme war emperor!"
"His combat prowess has long surpassed the realm of the Emperor, and he is known as the being closest to an 'immortal'. If the ancient immortal path had not been cut off, he might have ascended to immortality long ago. In terms of combat prowess, the ancestors of the Golden Ancient Clan are not even worthy of carrying his shoes!"
"It's a pity that at the end of the ancient times, the war that swept through all the worlds broke out, and even the great emperor fell like a piece of grass. After that battle, Emperor Huangtian also completely disappeared, and everyone thought he had fallen..."
When the master said this, he paused and looked at Aman under the statue with a complicated tone.
"Now it seems that the rumors may not be true. Boy, the little girl named Aman next to you may have a background as big as the sky! She is most likely a descendant of Emperor Huangtian!"
Chu Feng's heart jumped suddenly.
Descendants of Emperor Huangtian?
No wonder...no wonder she could ignore the restrictions, no wonder Shen Ting went to great lengths to find her.
What kind of key is this? This is obviously a little ancestor!
Chu Feng's eyes looked at Aman again and couldn't help but soften a little.
At this moment, the tall statue of Emperor Huangtian suddenly made a soft "click" sound.
I saw a gap between the blurred brows of the statue.
Immediately afterwards, a ball of light the size of a fist, emitting colorful light, slowly floated out from the gap.
The light mass seemed to contain a nascent universe, with countless ancient and mysterious runes circulating in and out of it. A wild aura that was purer and older than the statue itself swept across the entire space in an instant!
Heritage!
The real inheritance appears!
"Boom!"
Almost at the moment the light group appeared, the breathing of all the geniuses present became heavier, and unprecedented greed and fanaticism burst out from their eyes.
They could clearly feel the terrifying power contained in that ball of light!As long as you get it, let alone being number one on the list of geniuses in all realms, it is not impossible to achieve enlightenment and become an emperor in the future!
Chapter 534 Want to be the first to die? I'll make it happen for you!
"be mine!"
